## Definition of Done

- [ ] Tests written first and passing (`pnpm test`)
- [ ] Lint and docs checks clean (`pnpm lint`, `pnpm docs:check`)

- [ ] Doors stay thin: business rules live in `internal/domain` / `internal/app`

- [ ] ADR added (if a decision was made or changed)
- [ ] `docs/architecture/*` and `docs/GLOSSARY.md` updated (if what they describe changed)
- [ ] No personal data or secrets in code, fixtures, docs or logs
